boundaries: Execute all 29 original source analysis cases/assertions. Capture full pre/post arguments, job mutations, results/types/typed errors, client requests, custom-run outcomes, callback outcomes, exact unchanged file/link trees and seven source hashes. Normalize only verified pytest roots and noncontract concurrent outcome/client/callback event order by full value; preserve complete values and multiplicity, never claim source completion order.

Native actual Discover/DiscoverFile, PlanOutputs and Execute use source inputs or explicit typed hypothetical planning inputs and source-fake-derived contract-client responses, not SDK/service recordings. Native returns complete raw envelopes rather than Python helper deserialized objects; usage fallback, safe errors and aggregate failure are explicit. Batch results are persisted to native-only owned files to observe every full payload. Injected source run functions have native-only file bodies carrying the original ref and an explicit sourceRunnerResult envelope, not a fictitious native runner/callback API. Barrier probes measure the native worker bound; source callback observations stay distinct.

Native combines planning/disambiguation instead of mutating jobs; preserve original source pre/post paths and complete separate native plans. Discovery canonicalizes first-kept refs and rejects missing files instead of Python realpath dedupe fallback; preserve these unapproved differences, full source dropped pairs and complete safe native errors. JSON/markdown naming adapts to native full/LLM planning views without claiming renderer parity.

Public example.test SAS and fake documents are synthetic controls, never credentials or recordings. No network, service policy, production implementation or prior assets/reviews change. Extra probes/replacements add no source cases; Windows/live/host/platform/performance and reviewer gates remain separate.
